backendError.message: named agent layout-a/layout-b no longer owns the target terminal

layoutAfterFirstRealEnsureAttempt.assessment: Herdr pane split --direction right --ratio 0.4 assigned about 40% of width to the existing leader pane, not 40% to the new Worker pane. The implemented leader-width invariant fails on the first real Worker launch.

shutdown.semanticReceipt: Team stopped; 0 Workers stopped; 2 unfinished Tasks retained.

blockingEvidence: The real Team invocation issued the implemented first-worker Herdr split at ratio 0.4 and measured the leader at 33/82 width (40.24%), below the required 60%.
Herdr agent start failed for both Worker carriers with agent_name_not_found, so the two-Worker, worker_stop, and successful Worker-authored Task-event portions could not run.
nextAction: Change the Herdr first-split ratio according to its measured existing-pane semantics, add a focused geometry regression test, then repeat this isolated real-Team run. Separately diagnose the Herdr agent-start ownership failure before claiming an end-to-end Worker lifecycle result.
residualBackendGaps: The unit adapter tests treat 0.4 as a Worker share, but the live Herdr geometry shows it is the existing leader share.
The live Herdr agent-start path rejected both freshly split Worker panes as no longer owned by the named agent; deterministic mocks did not expose this failure.
